comparison: All nine task verdicts and saved metric dictionaries exactly match v1. This verifies the reporting-only correction left measured learning unchanged; the two source cohorts are not independent scientific repetitions. Baseline and anchor ablation both pass unused_token_hold and learned-MoG AE; the whole-penalty ablation additionally fails unused_token_hold. No efficacy ranking or false-reject claim is established without the independent references.
conclusion: Corrected-source smoke matrix: two_pole FAIL, unused_token_hold FAIL, ae_gan_hold PASS. Whole-screen FAIL; independent reference outcomes remain unmeasured. All selected attempts completed, with actual named-stream seed labels now consistent.
hypothesis: Removing the public critic gradient penalty tests whether cheap stability gates reject a substantively weakened formulation before quality work.
next_action: Keep ordinary qualification stopped and retain this frozen cohort. The two-cell learned-MoG GPU pilot is registered but must wait for the requested joint device window. Collect deeper independent references only through explicit diagnostic selections, then evaluate the unchanged calibration criteria before adoption.
